title: resources/unsubscribe request params
description: Params for the legacy MCP resources/unsubscribe method as accepted by Labby. Mirrors rmcp 3.1.0 UnsubscribeRequestParams. Unlike subscribe, this method does not validate the URI against the deliverable snapshot or route scope — a client must always be able to stop (contract C-7).

uri.description: URI to stop receiving updates for. Unsubscribing a URI that was never subscribed is an idempotent success.
